Name: Plant Dinos - New Custom Animals
Author: tiakall
Description:
When I first started modding my Stardew, mothfur's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4650]Bulbasaurus mod[/url] was the very first one I downloaded. With their permission I have converted the bestest of bulbs into purchasable animals you can get from Marnie.  This is a conversion of my old BFAV mod, now updated for 1.6 and CP.

[b]Will not work in Stardew Valley 1.5! Requires 1.6![/b]

Includes:
Bulbasaurus: The original green boi made by mothfur
Blue Bulbasaurus: A Bulbasaur based on the older-gen blue colors. 
Shiny Bulbasaurus: The yellow-green Bulbasaur, now occuring more frequently than 1/8192.
Calico Bulbasaurus: A regional variant of Bulbasaur, based on the Cactus Fruit.
Venusaurus: A big boi!  Lives in the barn, based on Gigantimax Venusaur, because giant floppy flower is the best.

They bring you the following presents:
[spoiler]
All the bulbs bring spring onions.  Because, you know, bulbs.  They will also all drop eggs so you can hatch 'em all. They rarely drop rare seeds.
Venusaurus brings tea leaves and Venusaur eggs, and rarely ancient seeds.[/spoiler]


Endless thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5575844]Lumina[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/95265773]max[/url] for [s]letting me shamelessly copy their homework[/s] giving me examples of 1.6 animals to reference and answering all my noob questions.  Please check out Lumina's [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/StardewValley/comments/1b0qr0e/visit_mount_vapius_release_planned_at_end_of_march/]Visit Mount Vapius[/url] and max's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/images/2481]Sunberry Village[/url] when they release!  And thanks to RiotGirl5989 who took some wonderful screenshots when I had no spoons and helped catch a couple of last minute bugs!

Downloads.Description: To install, unzip into your Mods folder.
